events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW street activation for eos Dewy Lip Shine with a branded truck, lip-product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Public entry, Dewy Lip Shine product sampling and advertised sweet treats are free while promotional inventory lasts.
events.caveats: Current NYC for FREE and Average Socialite listings agree that the activation is open to the public on September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway. No advance RSVP requirement is published. Samples and treats are promotional inventory and should be treated as while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. Walk-in public activation.

events.event_name: Mary Kay: Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW beauty activation built as an oversized vanity with beauty touch-ups, product giveaways and interactive photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Mary Kay advertises free public access and 10,000 free makeup and skin-care products to give away, subject to promotional inventory.
events.caveats: The Eventbrite page is organized by Mary Kay U.S. and confirms September 15, 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. Independent current listings also describe the experience as open to the public. An Eventbrite registration path exists, but the verified public listings do not establish that advance registration is mandatory, so it is treated as optional rather than required or approval-based.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. Free product inventory is finite; arrive earlier if giveaways are the priority.

events.event_name: Hempz × Ulta Beauty Serene Waters Pop-Up
events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square, 2 Herald Square / 1328 Broadway, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A one-day Hempz body-care pop-up at Ulta Beauty centered on the Serene Waters Magnesium Body Lotion, with a calming product experience and a pop-up beverage truck outside the store.
events.what_is_free: Entry to the public pop-up experience is free. A separate hosted meet-and-greet listing confirms the same activation and beverage truck; any gifts tied to purchase are not counted as free public giveaways.
events.caveats: Average Socialite lists the general pop-up as open to the public from 12:30–6:30 PM. The Eventbrite page independently confirms the Hempz × Ulta activation at the same store and specifies a 4–6:30 PM influencer meet-and-greet plus gifts with purchase. Do not imply those purchase-tied gifts are free to every visitor.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12:30–6:30 PM at Ulta Beauty Herald Square. The general pop-up is walk-in; the Tonya Michelle meet-and-greet has its own Eventbrite path and later time window.

events.event_name: Walk the Runway at Century 21 NYC
events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt St, New York, NY 10007
events.what_it_is: A two-day public Fashion Week runway activation on Century 21's main floor where anyone can walk the runway and be filmed for the store's social stories.
events.what_is_free: No ticket or invitation is required. Participants are advertised to receive a free Century 21 tote and up to five iron-on patches while supplies last, plus a $21-off-$100 store card valid through October 15, 2026.
events.caveats: Century 21's first-party page explicitly says there is no registration, ticket or invitation. Totes are while supplies last, and the discount card requires a $100 store purchase to redeem the $21 discount; that purchase condition does not apply to admission or the runway experience itself.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 and Wednesday, September 16 from 12–6 PM on the Dey Street side of the main floor at 22 Cortlandt Street. Walk in and join the line.
